description: This file defines a CMake function named `compile_aidl` used during the build process to generate source code from AIDL files. It includes detailed documentation on how to use this function, which parameters it accepts, and how it operates to invoke the aidl compiler with appropriate options.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: A CMake function to compile aidl files into source code, supporting configurable parameters such as language, include directories, and target output directory. It locates the aidl compiler tool and executes it with the specified options.
